name: HAI: Hardware-in-the-Loop Anomaly Detection Dataset
description: The HAI (Hardware-in-the-Loop Anomaly Detection) dataset was collected on a realistic industrial control system (ICS) testbed by the Cybersecurity and Telecommunications Research Division at Korea Information Security Agency (KISA) and Affiliated Institute of ETRI. The testbed models physical thermal power generation and pumped-storage hydroelectric plants controlled via GE, Emerson, and Siemens PLCs and DCS interconnected with a dSPACE HIL simulator. The HAI 21.03 release comprises time-series measurements across 78 SCADA variables sampled continuously every 1 second, providing 921,603 normal operation training timestamps and 402,005 test timestamps across 50 cyber-physical attack scenarios (1,323,608 timestamps total).
